# check_rpi

> A Nagios plugin for checking Raspberry Pi temperature.

The shell plugin reports Raspberry Pi temperature and accepts warning and critical thresholds for monitoring systems.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/check_rpi): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/check_rpi/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.
